edges.outcome_description: Distinguish strong price advantage from weak evidence confidence
edges.requirement_title: Strict separation of Deal Strength from Evidence Confidence
edges.causal_mechanism: Strict separation of Deal Strength from Evidence Confidence.
edges.observable_user_behavior: Direct user interaction with verified outcome capability.

Fares with confidence < 50% are capped at modest labels (e.g. 'Giá đáng chú ý') regardless of high discount.
'Deal cực nóng' strictly requires confidence >= 75% and Deal Score >= 80.
'Deal rất ngon' strictly requires confidence >= 65% and Deal Score >= 70.
